rounds.report:
CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline, representation level L1 (proxy). Round 001 (initial scene).

Interpretation of the 24 reference samples (observed): one continuous onboard FPV drone-race shot (no cuts) inside a night-lit football stadium with teal seating, a green field ringed by an asphalt track and teal wall, inflatable white/pink pentagon gates with red bases, lit tower gates, a pink/yellow frame gate, a canopy roof with floodlights and corner video boards. The drone climbs the end stands (0-2 s), goes through a purple/yellow-lit concourse opening (3-4 s, two other lit racing drones visible), returns over the bowl and dives to the field (5-7 s), flies along the south sideline through a pentagon gate (8.3 s), climbs into the far-end stands and an upper concourse (9-11.5 s), flips back out over the stands (12.5-13.5 s), descends past a tower gate to the field (14.6-15.6 s), turns hard on the track (16.7-17.7 s), runs along the sideline toward the tunnel (18.8 s) and enters a purple service tunnel under the stands (19.8-24 s). A broadcast lower-third panel and the drone's own red propellers are visible at fixed screen positions in every frame.

Geometry: rounded-rectangle (superellipse) stadium built from a few ribbon bands (wall, lower bowl, suite fascia with window texture, mezzanine, upper deck, canopy, facade), two concourse openings, primitive gates (pentagon = 5 boxes + bases, tower = 4 columns + platform, frame gates), corner boards as box + emissive panels, a box-section tunnel with a bend, procedural seat/grass/dash textures, point-cloud city lights. Two opponent drones (pink, green LEDs) follow the same racing line ahead of the camera. The camera carries proxy propeller blobs and a plain (text-free) lower-third panel.

Camera/timing: camera path is a centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through one keyframe per reference sample (positions, look targets, roll), then a tunnel-centreline parametrisation from 19.82 s. All state is computed analytically from time; 720 frames at 29.97 fps.

Inference vs observation: gate positions, the global course layout, stadium dimensions and the path between samples are inferred; several samples (12.5 s, 13.5 s, 20.9 s) are heavily blurred so their poses are rough guesses. No render feedback has been received yet; nothing has been verified.
